$comment: Uncached `test` task seconds per Nx project for the CI test-shard dealer (scripts/src/test-shard-dealer.ts). Source: era-D successful runs on hosted ubuntu runners at --parallel=1, tau-brain research/ci-decomposition-blueprint.md Part 1 F1/F2 and Part 2 F5 (median uncached task seconds). A project not listed weighs defaultSeconds: the queue run 42571800530 test-2 lane spent about 300 s on some 26 unlisted projects, near 12 s each, rounded up. The `ui:test:shard-<n>` tasks, which the test lanes deal in place of `ui` (CI throughput review ST-1), weigh a sixth of `ui:test` at 952 s (the review's 2026-11-18 p50) plus about 15 s of Vitest start-up each; `ui` stays for the release gate's sweep, which deals whole projects. Refresh when a listed project's median moves by more than a quarter, when a project is split, or when this snapshot is older than 60 days.
